description: Diagnostic module to investigate the importlib traceback pattern in recent smoke failures (registry_api.py, rug_pull_monitor.py, signal_analyser.py). Use importlib.util.find_spec() and importlib.util.module_from_spec() to identify which import statement is failing. Log module dependency tree. Scan recently-built files for potential circular imports. Do NOT modify target files - only produce diagnostic report via write_service log.
